name: promise-extractor
description: Finds the commitments you made in text you paste (your sent emails, a chat export, meeting notes): "I'll send it Friday", "let me check and get back to you". Lists each one with to whom, what, the due date and the exact quote, and which are overdue as of a date. Due dates are worked out in code from the message date; every quote is checked against your text, and nothing it can't find is shown. Follow-ups: as of another date, only overdue, only ones to a person, show sources, as json. It reads only what you paste: no mail or chat access, it never sends anything, and no general questions.

skills.name: Extract promises
skills.description: The commitments you made in pasted messages or notes (to whom, what, due, quote), with overdue ones as of a date, plus follow-ups on the same list.
examples: Here are my sent emails from this week: <paste>
Find what I promised in these notes, as of 2026-11-05: <paste>
Which of my promises are overdue?
